verdict.rationale: Pigment documents native connectors, open APIs and scheduled imports into its finance planning platform, plus variance analysis that tracks plans against actuals on the same platform. That covers the generic plan-versus-actuals loop, but nothing in the evidence specifically addresses revenue planning or sourcing from CRM pipeline or subscription data. Missing for 10: explicit revenue-planning capability, documented CRM/pipeline or subscription-billing connectors, revenue-specific actuals tracking, independent or hands-on corroboration.
